Handoff requirement: Identify the customer site user device and authoritative ticket
Evidence to capture: Customer ID site user contact device name serial or asset ID and ticket URL

Handoff requirement: State the reported symptom in the user's words and the technician's normalized description
Evidence to capture: Original request normalized symptom and any screenshots or recordings

Handoff requirement: Record business impact urgency and the evidence supporting the assigned priority
Evidence to capture: Affected users blocked workflow deadline safety revenue or compliance impact and priority rule

Handoff requirement: Define the observation window and last-known-good time
Evidence to capture: First observed recurrence pattern duration last-known-good time and time-zone source

Handoff requirement: Capture current endpoint identity and health
Evidence to capture: Hostname OS build boot time uptime agent status last check-in IP network free space and clock state

Handoff requirement: Capture resource pressure with comparable timestamped samples
Evidence to capture: CPU memory disk queue or latency network and top process samples with interval and units

Handoff requirement: Record relevant alerts incidents and monitoring gaps
Evidence to capture: Alert IDs thresholds start and clear times suppression maintenance windows and missing telemetry

Handoff requirement: Record recent changes and scheduled workloads
Evidence to capture: Patches software installs scripts policy changes scans backups reboots and remote sessions near symptom onset

Handoff requirement: Document bounded reproduction steps and expected versus actual behavior
Evidence to capture: Prerequisites numbered steps expected result actual result frequency and affected cohort

Handoff requirement: Record whether the symptom reproduces on a comparison endpoint or user
Evidence to capture: Comparison identity shared and differing conditions and timestamped result

Handoff requirement: Separate observed facts from working hypotheses
Evidence to capture: Direct observations log lines measurements and each unproven explanation

Handoff requirement: Identify missing evidence that prevents a conclusion
Evidence to capture: Unavailable logs expired telemetry inaccessible device permission gap or user not reachable

Handoff requirement: List every diagnostic or repair action in order
Evidence to capture: Command setting script tool operator start and end time scope and authorization

Handoff requirement: Attach before-and-after evidence for every state-changing action
Evidence to capture: Pre-change value post-change value output exit code logs screenshots and rollback point

Handoff requirement: Record failed attempts and why they were stopped
Evidence to capture: Action result error new evidence stop condition and whether rollback completed

Handoff requirement: State risky actions deliberately not taken
Evidence to capture: Security control disablement broad exclusion unapproved reboot reinstall data deletion or fleetwide change avoided

Handoff requirement: Ask one explicit question the receiving technician can answer
Evidence to capture: Required decision diagnosis permission specialist action or vendor escalation and why current evidence is insufficient

Handoff requirement: Assign the receiving queue owner and response target
Evidence to capture: Named queue technician backup route acknowledgement target and customer update cadence

Handoff requirement: Define acceptance and stop conditions before further work
Evidence to capture: Success metrics allowed scope maximum impact stop trigger and approval needed to continue

Handoff requirement: Provide rollback and emergency contact paths
Evidence to capture: Rollback steps recovery evidence decision owner after-hours contact and customer authority

Handoff requirement: Redact secrets and restrict sensitive attachments
Evidence to capture: Redaction completed storage location access list retention requirement and prohibited data removed

Handoff requirement: Preserve file and log integrity when evidence may support an incident
Evidence to capture: Original path collection method timestamp hash collector and chain-of-custody reference

Handoff requirement: Require the receiving technician to acknowledge the evidence and identify any missing item
Evidence to capture: Acknowledgement time receiver missing evidence request accepted question and revised priority

Handoff requirement: Close the loop with outcome retest prevention and knowledge updates
Evidence to capture: Root cause fix comparable retest customer confirmation follow-up owner and knowledge article or monitoring change
